note: What a server streaming a match to a watching client sends first, within 30 seconds of the client's request: how long its chunks and key frames run. A client waits on it, and stops taking the stream's messages once the last chunk has arrived. The header carries zero.

fields.name: text
fields.note: A JSON object with integer members chunkTimeInterval and keyFrameTimeInterval, in milliseconds, to the end of the message. A server sends both.
